import os

token = os.getenv("HOSTILE_SECRET_VALUE")
os.putenv("HTTPS_PROXY", "https://proxy.invalid")
os.unsetenv("HTTPS_PROXY")
os.environ["TOKEN"] = "value"
del os.environ["TOKEN"]
list(filter(os.getenv, ["TOKEN"]))
from functools import partial
list(filter(partial(os.getenv), ["TOKEN"]))
partial(os.getenv).func("TOKEN")
for os.environ["LOOP_TARGET"] in ["value"]:
    pass

from contextlib import nullcontext
with nullcontext("value") as os.environ["WITH_TARGET"]:
    pass
